model_selection_memo.question: Which open-literature transitional-regime model of molecular-drag / turbomolecular compression can be implemented with every coefficient cited?
criteria: full text openly and lawfully accessible
closed-form or reproducible relation with all coefficients stated
covers free molecular -> transitional (Kn dependence of compression and speed)
reduces to the production free-molecular model in the overlap

candidates.why: only accessed model meeting all criteria: closed form, every factor stated, explicit continuum and free-molecular limits, reduces exactly to DragCompressor's linear Gaede characteristic in the free-molecular limit (with xi <-> sigma mapping)
limitations: sigma is a fitting parameter (no a-priori value)
plane channel: no groove side walls, land leakage, curvature, centrifugal effects
single gas; not a mixture model

candidates.why: best physics basis (linearized kinetic equation, experimentally compared), but the groove-flow solutions (Couette/Poiseuille coefficients vs rarefaction and groove shape) are in the non-open paper

candidates.source: CT-S05 survey: Helmer-Levi, Sawada, Giors slip CFD
candidates.why: primary papers not open; secondary equation incomplete
no open coefficients; see gap memo

model_selection_memo.result: Skovorodko Eq. (1) implemented as CANDIDATE_NOT_ADMITTED for drag-channel stages only.

consistency_check_vs_DragCompressor.label: CONSISTENCY_CHECK_CONFIGURATION_NOT_A_DESIGN_POINT

configuration.DragCompressor: defaults except L_per_stage_m = 0.005 (chosen so outlet stays <= 0.1 Pa)

interpretation: zero-throughput: the two free-molecular compressions coincide by construction (sigma mapped from xi); the residual lnK difference is the Eq. (1) viscous/slip correction and grows ~linearly with pressure

finite throughput: DragCompressor applies xi to the pumping speed (S0 = xi u h w/2) while the plane-channel model has S0 = u h w/2, so DragCompressor loses compression 1/xi times faster with throughput; this is a structural model difference, not a numerical error, and is unresolved without T-2 data

default_geometry_finding.note: with the default 0.35 m drag stage DragCompressor's free-molecular characteristic implies outlet pressures far above 0.1 Pa (outside its own domain), where the candidate saturates through the viscous term; both are out of the production domain -> NOT_EVALUATED_OUT_OF_DOMAIN

predict the transitional-regime points blind (no refit, no geometry retuning)
